**Research Scientist, [Google DeepMind](https://deepmind.google)** · **Research Associate Professor, [NYU](https://csmapnyu.org/)** · **[ML Commons](https://mlcommons.org)**

Working on evaluation science and the socioeconomic impacts of AI systems. Full [bio here](bio.qmd).

**Current Projects**

- **Measurement** — hidden [error in LLM evals & benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11581) and how to reduce it. Measuring the [spread of ideas across languages](/publications/waightmessing2025/) using fine-tuned LLMs. Estimating [ideology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.12057) using forced-choice LLM-as-judge frameworks.
- **AI & Democracy** — what LLMs refuse and the political consequences. How [state media in training data shapes model output](https://state-media-influence-llm.github.io). Alignment choices and democratic outcomes.
- **Economic impacts** — simulating real-world economic tasks to understand [model capabilities related to labor-market impacts](https://deepmind.google/blog/deepening-our-partnership-with-the-uk-ai-security-institute/).
